name: 304 Seconds
source:
Kuroya starts his day... by waking up tied to a chair.
That's not exactly planned. But at least he's not alone!

[from [url=https://nobreadstudio.itch.io/304-seconds-jam-edition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黑也被绑在椅子上醒来，开始了他的一天。
这并不是完全计划好的。但至少他并不孤单！

[来自[url=https://nobreadstudio.itch.io/304-seconds-jam-edition]itch.io[/url]]
